record.paper_title: Billiard Dynamics: A Survey with the Emphasis on Open Problems
record.original_question: For a rational polygon P, does the limit lim_{ℓ→∞} f_P(ℓ)/ℓ^2 exist, where f_P(ℓ) counts periodic bands of length at most ℓ? Equivalently, does every rational polygon have quadratic asymptotics?

evidence.quote: In all examples computed so far fP (￿)/￿2 has a limit, i. e., c∗(P) = c∗(P) = c(P). In this case, we say that the polygon has quadratic asymptotics.
Problem 13. Does every rational polygon have quadratic asymptotics?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a rational polygon, i.e. a planar polygon all of whose interior angles are rational multiples of $\pi$. Consider the billiard flow inside $P$ (a point particle moving in straight lines and reflecting elastically off the boundary). A periodic billiard trajectory in $P$ comes in a maximal connected family of parallel periodic trajectories of the same length, called a periodic band (or cylinder of periodic orbits). For $\ell > 0$, let $f_P(\ell)$ denote the number of periodic bands in $P$ whose length is at most $\ell$. Define
$$c^*(P) = \limsup_{\ell \to \infty} \frac{f_P(\ell)}{\ell^2}, \qquad c_*(P) = \liminf_{\ell \to \infty} \frac{f_P(\ell)}{\ell^2}.$$
One says that $P$ has quadratic asymptotics if $c_*(P) = c^*(P)$, i.e. the limit
$$c(P) = \lim_{\ell \to \infty} \frac{f_P(\ell)}{\ell^2}$$
exists in $[0, \infty)$.

Question: Does every rational polygon $P$ have quadratic asymptotics?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether $f_P(\ell)/\ell^2$ has a limit for every rational polygon (quadratic asymptotics) is a well-known open problem in the dynamics of rational billiards. Eskin–Masur and subsequent work by Eskin–Mirzakhani–Mohammadi establish quadratic upper and lower bounds and prove existence of the limit for almost every translation surface in each stratum, but the existence of the exact limit for every individual rational polygon remains unresolved. No published resolution was found in the search.

status_evidence.title: Rational billiards and flat structures (Masur–Tabachnikov, Handbook of Dynamical Systems)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses upper/lower quadratic bounds c_*(P), c^*(P) for counts of periodic cylinders in rational polygons and the open question of whether they coincide.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of the limit c(P) = lim f_P(ℓ)/ℓ^2 for every rational polygon is stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Some remarks on periodic billiard orbits in rational polygons
status_evidence.snippet: Earlier work on counting periodic billiard orbits in rational polygons; gives quadratic bounds but not the exact asymptotic for every polygon.
status_evidence.claim: Quadratic bounds are known, but the existence of the exact limit for arbitrary rational polygons is not established.
